summary: Telecommunications (Financial Hardship) Industry Standard 2024. Bound: s 4(a): carriage service providers that supply telecommunications products to residential, small business and not-for-profit customers.

clauses.heading: Minimum requirements - communicating with customers
clauses.text: A provider must, where it communicates with a customer and the customer indicates they are a financial hardship customer: (a) advise the customer about the provider's payment assistance policy and how to make an application; (b) discuss the provider's options for assistance
clauses.notes: Provision read: s 15(1). Agent hears hardship and only demands payment or offers a standard payment date without explaining the payment assistance policy, options and how to apply.

clauses.heading: Minimum requirements - communicating with customers
clauses.text: uses any language that indicates they are having financial difficulties, including any of the following, or similar, terms to describe their financial situation: money problems, difficulty, struggling, trouble, issues, problems, low income, cost of living or pressure
clauses.notes: Provision read: s 15(2)(e). Sets the low trigger: phrases like 'struggling with cost of living' count; agent that fails to recognise them misses the obligation.

clauses.heading: Minimum requirements - assessing eligibility
clauses.text: a provider must not request a customer to provide information (including documents) to show that they are in a financial hardship situation: (a) subject to subsection (3), if: (i) the application is for short term assistance; or (ii) it appears that the customer may be a victim survivor of domestic or family violence
clauses.notes: Provision read: s 16(2). Agent demands payslips or bank statements for short term help or from a possible DFV victim survivor.

clauses.heading: No charge for financial hardship assistance
clauses.text: A customer must not be charged by a provider: (a) to apply for, or be assessed for, financial hardship assistance; (b) to access an arrangement for financial hardship assistance; or (c) for the administration of such arrangements.
clauses.notes: Provision read: s 21. Agent quotes a fee for setting up a payment arrangement.

clauses.heading: Minimum requirements - assessing credit management action
clauses.text: offer the customer financial hardship assistance suitable for the customer's situation; and (b) take all reasonable steps to keep the customer's telecommunications service connected, having regard to the essential nature of carriage services
clauses.notes: Provision read: s 23(2). Agent moves straight to suspension or disconnection for a customer known to be in hardship.

clauses.heading: Minimum requirements - taking credit management action
clauses.text: a provider must not take credit management action against a customer: (a) while the customer is discussing options, or has made an application, for financial hardship assistance with the provider; or (b) if the provider has an arrangement for financial hardship assistance on foot
clauses.notes: Provision read: s 24(1). Agent threatens or initiates restriction, suspension or disconnection while hardship options are being discussed. s 24(5) requires disconnection only as a last resort with 10 business days written notice including TIO and financial counselling contacts.
